adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a sustained offset beginning around index 462 (large jump in N/E/U: ~+5.3, -11.0, -10.2) and persisting through index 471, with no return to pre-offset levels within the interval; P1 (single-point at 462) and P2 (single-point at 470) are isolated spikes inconsistent with a temporary platform. The interior observations (462–471) show coherent motion on elevated baseline, indicating a genuine temporary offset spanning multiple days—not two independent single-day events. No opposing return is observed in this window, but the sustained shift across all axes supports a single temporary platform from ~462 to ~471, not the proposed pair IDs.
